ambiguities.detail: Every subpath has a '@zod/source' condition -> ./src/*.ts alongside types/import/require -> dist. M0 does not support custom conditions: same specifier resolves to src (dev) or dist (published) depending on the condition set. The choice of condition set for Flowprint is a product decision; v0.1-alpha encodes the fallback behavior, not the condition.

'./v4/locales/*' maps types/import/require all to the bare pattern './v4/locales/*' with no extension rewriting; resolving 'zod/v4/locales/fr' statically requires file-system expansion (64 locale .ts files verified present).
src/index.ts does 'export { z, z as default }' — the default export is a namespace alias, not a separate value; surface extraction must not double-count it.
